Just format the code with black and we can merge.

@MartinHjelmare 

Retesting (Python 3.9-64 on Windows) I get this error message:
```
    def last_reset(self) -> datetime | None:
TypeError: unsupported operand type(s) for |: 'type' and 'NoneType'
```

Pylance suggests that the `|` requires Python 3.10 or newer, so we probably have to do that a different way.
Oh I see the CI black has some changes it wants, let me roll those in

Finally figured out why I can't seem to override my built-in neurio_energy on HassOS (this bit of doc [pending a merge] was the key to understanding the problem: https://github.com/home-assistant/developers.home-assistant/pull/1025)

Adding a numeric version (`pr-54445` didn't work) to `manifest.json` did the trick:
```json
  "version": "54445"
```

I fixed the typing compatability here:
https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/54445/commits/156bbd371f21e706b02e27001f282a08fa096bbd

So we don't need to revert anything. Just address the remaining comment above.
@deftdawg , is there any chance this could be closed soon, you have a user on the other side of the planet that needs this fix. Anyway you can help?

I'm looking at the development blog and it seems like last_reset is supposed to be removed in favour of a never resetting total accumulation.   I'm missing how this is a drop-in replacement.

The Neurio app resets the KwH count every day, so if we're to keep consistent with the app we'll need to figure out how to reimplement a daily reset not using `last_reset()`

> @deftdawg , is there any chance this could be closed soon, you have a user on the other side of the planet that needs this fix. Anyway you can help?

@mpancino If you want to see my soon to be obsolete patch work, you can install `vscode server add-on` and drop the contents 
https://github.com/deftdawg/home-assistant/tree/neurio_energy_energy_fix/homeassistant/components/neurio_energy into a `custom_component/neuro_energy` folder, then add a `version` to the manifest.json so HA takes your custom over the stock version, i.e.
```
{
  "domain": "neurio_energy",
  "name": "Neurio energy",
  "documentation": "https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/neurio_energy",
  "requirements": ["neurio==0.3.1"],
  "codeowners": [],
  "iot_class": "cloud_polling",
  "version": "54445"
}
```

Restart HA and then you're ready to see it work... 

Then you can edit the code in `custom_component/neuro_energy`, restarting HA each time to see if your changes worked.

state class has been changed to `STATE_CLASS_TOTAL_INCREASING` and last_reset has been removed, seems the change in state class has things resetting hourly and daily fine, I watched at midnight to confirm that...  think this PR is finally done.

issue_context.title: Neurio / PWRView grid consumption for Energy view not available
issue_context.body:
### The problem

[Per the 2021.8 release party](https://youtu.be/VLiqDkam33k?t=5638) reporting this for tracking.

Neurio Energy supports measurement of "Daily Energy Usage" in kWh, however it is not available as a grid consumption option.

``sensor.daily_energy_usage``:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4991612/128271750-5afdb811-cfde-45b7-9f9c-1feea80cec9a.png)

The grid consumption view:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4991612/128271845-8521843a-1a7b-4c47-846f-7004b8628be9.png)

From merge #52117, it seems as though it should have the required ``measurement`` state class already setup.  

The settings panel of the sensor.daily_energy_usage says ``This entity ("sensor.daily_energy_usage") does not have a unique ID, therefore its settings cannot be managed from the UI. See the documentation for more detail.``, so I wonder if that might by why it cannot be choosen from the Energy tab.

If that's the case, how might I fix it?



### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2021.8.0

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Neurio

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/neurio_energy/

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

_No response_

### Additional information

_No response_
comments:
Some other observations that might possibly explain the incompability based on comparsions to Wemo and TPLink sensor classes:

- Neurio_Energy code seems to predate async setup

- Neurio_Energy is missing device classes
  - device_class = DEVICE_CLASS_ENERGY for ACTIVE_TYPE
  - device_class = DEVICE_CLASS_POWER for DAILY_TYPE

- Only ACTIVE_TYPE has `self._attr_state_class = STATE_CLASS_MEASUREMENT`

The fix ended up being:

- Adding device_classes per the previous comment
- and a last_reset property definition
```python
     @property
    def last_reset(self) -> datetime:
        """Return the time when the sensor was initialized."""
        return dt_util.start_of_local_day()
```

More info here:
https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/core/entity/sensor/#properties
